error[L0305]: a field selection reads storage, which a module value cannot: nothing runs before the entry point to read it
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/module-value-imported-field/main.ldn:6:14
  |
6 | first: i32 = shapes.origin.first
  |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  = note: [1940]: a module value folds literals, known names, another module's values named through it and [1820]'s operators on them, never a field or an element
error[L0305]: a module value has to be one the compiler knows when it reads it, and a call runs a routine to find it
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/module-value-imported-field/main.ldn:7:15
  |
7 | called: i32 = shapes.answer()
  |               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  = note: [1940]: nothing runs before the entry point [1460], and there is no compile-time execution
